svg.aria-label: Architecture of the review assistant: an offline step builds the search indexes and statistics; each question is planned, searched, counted, gated, answered and checked, and every model output passes a code check before it reaches the user.
svg.text: rebuilt daily or weekly; no LLM
Each run writes a new versioned copy; it must pass the golden
set, then replicas switch to it one at a time (rollback = old copy).
POST /ask: stateless, scale out with replicas
LLM provider (OpenAI-compatible API): one model, three calls per question
One model and one setting for all calls (gpt-4o-mini, Gemini or a local model). Each call is separate and sees only its own prompt.
Timeout and retries on every call. If the model is down, the service still returns evidence and statistics.
Declines return a reason and message and never call the LLM for an answer.
If a check fails, the evidence is still returned with answer: null.
every stage emits timings, counters, decline reasons
one JSON line per request, no question text
latency per stage, declines, LLM failures
